title: Easy Flaky Spanish Fish Empanadas
description: A kid-friendly Spanish dish featuring lemons and fish, with a flaky crust and a hint of fermented flavor, suitable for diabetic diets.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the chopped onion, minced garlic, and cod fish.
Add the lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and black pepper to the bowl and stir until combined.
If using fermented fish sauce, add it to the bowl and stir well.
Roll out the empanada dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a tablespoon of the fish mixture onto the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough in half over the filling and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with a little bit of olive oil and bake for 20 minutes, or until golden brown.
